subject: Redwood x BrightPath - Integrator Acceleration Roadmap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@brightpath.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood x BrightPath - Integrator Acceleration Roadmap

Hi Carlos —

Thanks for the productive conversation last week. As discussed, we want to set a concise Integrator Acceleration plan to get BrightPath consultants trained, certified, and ready to co-deliver Redwood-powered solutions to your pilot accounts within 6 weeks.

High-level proposal (packed as a short kickoff):
- Week 0: Intake & security alignment (questionnaires, environment access)
- Week 1–2: Solution deep-dive + hands-on sandbox labs
- Week 3: Certification exercise + joint runbook review
- Week 4–6: Co-delivery pilot & retro + knowledge transfer

Immediate asks from BrightPath so we can finalize the MAP: a) a list of your technical leads + availability for a 60-minute workshop; b) any legal/infosec contacts and SOC2/arch materials we should expect.

I'm attaching a short intake template to capture the basics and a proposed kickoff agenda. Once we have the names and one time slot, Ben will lock in a technical lead from our side and Jonas will coordinate the partner enablement credits.

Would Tuesday 10/13 at 10am PT work for a 60-minute kickoff? If not, propose two alternate slots and we'll adapt.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Partner Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachment: brightpath-enablement-intake.pdf (PDF, 86KB)

From: Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@brightpath.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Redwood x BrightPath - Integrator Acceleration Roadmap

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear plan. Tuesday 10/13 10am PT works for our core team (me, Elena Park — lead engineer, and Maria Lopez — partner ops).

Quick notes from our side: we do need a short pre-kickoff security sync because our procurement requires a pointer to your SOC2 scope and a sample data flow diagram before we run legal. I attached a filled intake with contacts and a short list of sandbox requirements.

Also, two asks we want on the table during the kickoff:
1) Can Redwood provide a simple runbook for sandbox provisioning (we prefer Terraform snippets + a minimal IAM profile)?
2) We want clarity on certification criteria for our consultants (pass/fail checklist + sample exercise).

We attached our intake and a sample NDA our legal team prefers (we can sign your form if needed).

On attachments: brightpath-enablement-intake-filled.pdf, brightpath-nda-sample.docx

Thanks — looking forward to Tuesday.

—Carlos
Director, Strategic Partnerships
BrightPath Consulting

Carlos / team —

Great to meet you (virtually) this morning. Following the kickoff, attaching a practical "Integrator Accel Checklist" we typically use for partner ramp. It includes explicit lab exercises, a Terraform snippet for sandbox provisioning, and the certification rubric (score thresholds + sample exercise).

Quick clarifications from the workshop notes:
- For the sandbox, we'll provide an environment template and a per-partner IAM role; Laura to email the Terraform snippet to your infra lead after this thread.
- Certification: 70% pass threshold for the hands-on exercise + 80% required on the written checklist. We can tailor exercises for your consultants if you share 2 example profiles.
- Procurement: Jonas will follow up with a SOC2 extract and architecture diagram by EOD.

Attachments: redwood-integrator-accel-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)

Thanks — I'll coordinate the lab schedule once we have the list of 8 consultants from BrightPath.

—Laura
Field Enablement Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Redwood x BrightPath - MAP and next steps (signed docs + scheduling)

Carlos —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our checklist and the intake you returned, I've uploaded the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and the SOC2 extract to the shared folder and routed the MAP through DocuSign for signature. Links below:
- MAP (Redwood-BrightPath): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cBrightPathOnramp
- DocuSign (MAP): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/DocuSign-MAP-BrightPath-2026

Summary of agreed next steps (short):
1) BrightPath to sign the MAP via DocuSign (target: 10/18)
2) Redwood to deliver the Terraform sandbox snippet and IAM role by 10/16 (Laura will share)
3) Joint lab schedule: week of 10/26 — Laura will propose time slots once consultants list received
4) Certification window: 11/16–11/20 with pass criteria from the checklist

Attachments included in Drive: MAP-BrightPath-Redwood-2026.docx, SOC2-scope-extract.pdf

Ben / Marissa — I've allocated the partner enablement credit and noted a 10% pilot discount in the deal record (DP-2026-0928). Carlos — if procurement needs a PO path or contract redline, loop in your legal and we can fast-track.

Thanks all — looking forward to the first lab.

—Jonas Weber
Head of Alliances
Redwood Inference
